extracted.name: Mozzarella-stuffed French toast
extracted.description: Try French toast with mozzarella and chilli sauce for an indulgent weekend brunch
ingredient_lines: 4 slices of thick white bread crusts removed
instruction_lines: Divide the mozzarella between 2 slices of bread, leaving a 1cm border. Sandwich both with another slice of bread, then press the edges with a fork to seal.
Beat the egg and the milk in a dish, add the sandwiches and leave to soak for 1 min, turning once.
Fry the sandwiches in the butter over a medium heat for 5 mins, then flip and cook for 5 mins more, until golden on both sides. Serve with chilli sauce.
